customManagers.description: Track the vendored container-setup release setup.sh asset

packageRules.description: Use a readable topic for the vendored container-setup setup.sh release asset

commands: case "{{{packageName}}}" in Strukturpiloten/container-setup) setup_version=$(sed -n 's/^CONTAINER_SETUP_VERSION="\([^"]*\)"$/\1/p' deps/container-setup/setup.sh); test -n "$setup_version" && curl -fsSLo deps/container-setup/setup.sh "https://github.com/Strukturpiloten/container-setup/releases/download/$setup_version/setup.sh" && chmod 0755 deps/container-setup/setup.sh ;; *) true ;; esac
